Name: Huddlestock
Company description: Huddlestock Fintech AS is a pioneering technology provider based in Stavanger, Norway, specializing in Investment as a Service (IaaS) solutions tailored for the wealth management industry. Founded in 2014, Huddlestock made history as Norway's first publicly traded fintech company and has since expanded its capabilities through strategic acquisitions. The company's mission is to democratize access to capital markets by offering low-cost, efficient trading and investment services, thereby promoting financial inclusion. Huddlestock collaborates closely with a diverse range of clients, including neobanks, fintech startups, and established financial institutions, providing them with customizable, reliable, and innovative solutions tailored to their unique needs. The company focuses on digitizing work processes for custody banks, asset managers, and trading venues through its open, compliance-optimized wealthtech platform, which facilitates end-to-end digital services such as onboarding, client communication, and portfolio management. Huddlestock aims to enhance efficiency and reduce costs for its clients by delivering a differentiated real-time product that integrates various financial services. Its clientele spans across Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Germany, and the UK, and the company has established partnerships with notable firms in the financial sector. With a strong emphasis on research and development, Huddlestock is committed to continuous innovation, ensuring that its clients can adapt to evolving market trends and consumer needs. The company also offers consultancy services to support clients in optimizing their operations and investment solutions. As a publicly traded entity, Huddlestock is regulated by financial authorities in Norway and Germany, underscoring its dedication to compliance and operational excellence. Through its commitment to flexibility and collaboration, Huddlestock empowers businesses to deliver modern investment experiences while navigating the challenges of the rapidly evolving financial landscape.

Name: InvestWiser AS
Company description: InvestWiser AS bygger fremtidens verktøy for den datadrevne investor. Vi er et norsk fintech-selskap som gjør avansert aksjeanalyse tilgjengelig, intuitiv og intelligent. PROBLEMET VI LØSER: Dagens marked er fylt med støy. Privatinvestorer og profesjonelle aktører mangler ofte verktøy som er både kraftfulle nok til å gi reell innsikt, og enkle nok til å brukes effektivt i en travel hverdag. Resultatet er beslutninger basert på følelser, og tapte muligheter. VÅR LØSNING: EN INTELLIGENT ALT-I-ETT-PLATTFORM InvestWiser er en skybasert plattform som gir deg et urettferdig fortrinn. Vi kombinerer: 📊 Systematisk Dataanalyse: Identifiser selskaper basert på anerkjente faktormodeller (Kvalitet, Verdi, Momentum) gjennom vår kraftige og fleksible aksjescreener. 🤖 AI-drevet Co-pilot: Still komplekse spørsmål om selskaper, nøkkeltall og markedsforhold til vår integrerte AI-assistent og få datadrevne, kontekstuelle svar på sekunder. 💼 Helhetlig Porteføljestyring: Bygg, analyser og overvåk dine porteføljer med en dypere forståelse av risiko, diversifisering og reell avkastning. VÅR REISE OG FREMDRIFT: Grunnlagt av Didrik Lysvoll i 2021, har InvestWiser vokst organisk til over 8.000 brukere. Vi er støttet av Innovasjon Norge og anerkjente investorer fra det norske finans- og teknologimiljøet. I 2025 lanserte vi vår kommersielle v2.0-plattform og har validert vår SaaS-modell med våre første betalende kunder. BLI MED OSS: Vi er på en misjon for å styrke investorer med bedre verktøy og klarere innsikt. Følg vår reise her på LinkedIn for oppdateringer om produktutvikling, markedsanalyser og innsikt i fintech-innovasjon. Utforsk plattformen i dag på https://investwiser.no/.

Name: Risk-Partner AS
Company description: Risk-Partner offers low cost and high performance solutions for improved credit management to everyone. Our solutions provides clients with better decision making through machine based learning and equal parts external and internal data. Our solutions and technology have found a particular sweetspot in the marketplace.  We believe it is due to its high adaptability, many possible uses and low complexity and cost in implementation. Risk-Partner AS is owned by its founders together with LM Media Holding and the investment firm IHK. Our work is supported by Innovation Norway (Norwegian Government) and The Research Council of Norway.

Name: TrendTech AS

Name: UpScore - Boosting Your Financial Wellbeign
Company description: UpScore is a tech start-up on a mission to boost consumers' financial engagement and wellbeing. Our solution combines cutting-edge data capture, credit scoring and analytics with tailored interactive advice and tools that empowers consumers to take informed actions to improve their financial position and everyday relationship to money. We believe that knowledge is power and aim to put the consumer in the drivers seat through adding financial literacy and granting full understanding, ownership and control of their credit data and personal finances.   But this is not a one-way street!  UpScores ability to engage and gather rich customer data also fuels a next-generation scoring platform with ability to accelerate financial institutions towards the next level of their credit decisioning – creating win-win relationships between banks, insurers and consumers.   Our vision is to build the next-generation ecosystem and tool for fun and interactive everyday personal finance management.  UpScore was founded 2021 and is based in Oslo, Norway. Core Business:  FinTech, Scoring, Credit Policy, Banking, Loans, Debit Cards, Financial Literacy, Broker, Lending, PSD2
